اعتقدتما (form VIII)
# اِعْتَقَدْتُمَا (iʕtaqadtumā) /iʕ.ta.qad.tu.maː/: second-person dual past active of اِعْتَقَدَ (iʕtaqada)
# اُعْتُقِدْتُمَا (uʕtuqidtumā) /uʕ.tu.qid.tu.maː/: second-person dual past passive of اِعْتَقَدَ (iʕtaqada)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
